summary: Read all 50 Chinese units and checked all 42 items and 12 people. This is a complete negative audit, not approval. Main defects are transferred relative dates, posthumous ancestor activity, invented last-three-year Tonghe precision, omitted age-over-forty evidence, and recoverable one-sided chronology left absent. Correct era arithmetic is distinguished from incorrect event ownership. No exact Gregorian month/day conversion or birth calculation was invented. Source and canonical extraction remain unchanged; repairs require fresh independent review.

itemChecks.reason: The sentence explicitly supplies Baoning for his own entry and ensuing promotions. The Liao table gives Baoning 1 as AD 969 and Qianheng beginning in 979, so 969-979 is the conventional era-label envelope, not an assertion of continuous service or Gregorian day-level bounds. No relative is substituted as actor.
